values.scope: Complete fixed-pool producer, observation-owner, exclusive lease and test-caller correction. All original limits and assertions remain. No runtime source or independent SMP-family promotion.
values.formalDuty: OpenSysML SDK resolves the actual producer/lease/receipt owners. Existing ASCENT gates bind the exact Git Python source period, complete test consumers and historical CI failure inventory. Existing QNT/Lean runtime duties remain distinct and unchanged.
values.efficiency.rule: Correctness closure and a local positive measurement establish foundation work. An efficiency-upgrade claim additionally needs a complete predeclared paired benchmark population with matching workload and resource limits, all planned repeated observations, pause/throughput/RSS rows and explicit fixed-overhead accounting. Build, load, allocation, GC and cleanup costs stay included. Missing or unmeasured dimensions deny the upgrade claim. Retain unfavorable observations; one favorable row cannot cancel a measured regression. RSS must identify its scope and must not be relabeled as physical peak memory. This is necessary evidence, not a statistical or universal speedup theorem.
values.comment.rule: Every REV, including small corrections, must publish its reviewed audit in the Git commit body: exact responsibility/retirement, reproducible tests and results, evidenced benefits, added costs, current process, repository Org checklist, distinct model duties and remaining gaps. Bind the report before ASCENT admission and reject later changes. Every user-facing progress/final report must identify the problem solved or still under qualification, stable checklist item, closed and remaining obligations with their counting unit, position/dependencies in the programme, and why the retired authority/work is a fundamental responsibility replacement with a falsifier. A planned item, scoped leaf, whole-stage closure and full SMP acceptance are different units; never derive an SMP percentage from test or REV counts. DEV refactoring progress is independent of SMP patch-line milestones; no 8-12 credit transfers
values.comment.matrixRule: Every future REV audit binds a nonempty structured benefit/cost matrix to the same base/tree/profile. Numeric values, units and sample counts come from durable source-bound evidence, with raw origin pointers checked against the recorded values, not literal narrative guesses. Record workload, method and limitation for each row. Compute signed delta/percent only with defined baselines; zero baseline has no percentage or ratio. Single observations remain observations; control timings, source accounting and structural benefits are not runtime speedup. Missing/stale matrix, row fields or evidence block ASCENT admission. Any source-bound measured regression blocks publication even when another row improves. Runtime integrations additionally require at least one measured positive benefit; unmeasured, control and structural rows do not establish it. Local DENY packets retain adverse observations; they cannot be submitted as qualified REV commits or PR comments. A noisy unfavorable cohort remains a refusal until positive net benefit is established, never resampled selectively or hidden. Historical published audit packets remain immutable; later supplements are labeled separately.
values.comment.deliveryRule: Every submission declares one integration result or an explicit support correction. Runtime integration requires every result obligation, transitive predecessor obligation and component source/native case on the exact tested tree/profile, with durable reviewed evidence; five audit gates alone never permit a fragment. Support corrections declare exact non-runtime paths, no integration target and zero progress. Header/runtime/generator semantic work cannot disguise itself as support. Missing classification, omitted case, stale receipt, unrelated runtime path or claimed support progress blocks. Historical admissions remain immutable; future models must adopt this contract. Raw Git remains a human/external boundary, not an authority enforced by this framework.
values.tests.scope: All six whole test modules finish158 tests with zero failure/error/skip and no input changes. Cover real exclusive lease, both receipt layouts, foreign owners, deadline/preparation, payload capture and unknown child refusal; synthetic stubs remain test-only.
values.learning.scope: Bind producer and lease consumer in one cut. Directory spelling is not ownership; use the existing task_output authority. Frozen full Python source periods prevent reliance on dirty unselected imports.
values.process.scope: Correct the observed CI pre-execution barriers without changing Gambit, heap, limits or assertions. KeepSMP4/12; full historical framework failure inventory remains visible and is not waived.
values.models.scope: Strict pinned OpenSysML SDK resolves all four model-listed components; existing ASCENT binds this exact support cut and refuses missing/stale gates.
values.questions.scope: Answer exact owner, observation/lease identity, source period, synthetic-versus-native lifecycle and remaining platform/history boundaries. Never infer global CI success or SMP-family progress.
values.gate.tests.purpose: All tests required by this source cut must finish with exact source and profile receipts. Missing, timeout, unknown or newly introduced/related failures block. A retained baseline failure may be classified outside the cut only by an explicit SysML/ASCENT source-input equivalence and scope-disjointness proof, complete unchanged manifests and real scoped tests; it remains a failure and vetoes whole-family acceptance. No name-only allowlist, manifest reduction or retry-until-green qualifies
values.gate.learning.purpose: State each claimed benefit, mechanism, retired responsibility, added cost and corresponding test/source evidence. Separate measured results from theoretical conditions; no inferred speedup
values.gate.process.purpose: Disclose the current refactoring stage, dependencies, remaining steps and acceptance boundary. Justify every official-source change by the selected responsibility replacement; retain official names and build entrypoints unless their replacement is necessary and evidenced
values.gate.models.purpose: Native SysML drives ASCENT; select QNT schedules and Lean laws only for applicable semantic changes, with distinct duties and actual source-refinement boundaries
values.gate.questions.purpose: Answer the mandatory Gambit-paper, semantic, amplification and counterexample questions within the claimed cut; unresolved mandatory answers block
